title: risb-wannier: rotationally invariant slave-boson solver for Wannier90 Hamiltonians
description: risb-wannier solves the rotationally invariant slave-boson (multi-orbital Gutzwiller) saddle-point equations in the embedding formulation for multi-orbital Hubbard models whose one-body part is read directly from wannier90_hr.dat (VASP, Quantum ESPRESSO), spinless or with spin-orbit coupling. It supports Kanamori, Slater-Condon and arbitrary U_ijkl interactions, fully localised-limit double counting, symmetry-adapted R and Lambda, exact-diagonalisation embedding, interaction-ramp continuation, one-shot DFT+RISB and a linearised charge self-consistency loop, with multi-core parallelism and benchmark checks.
